# Measurement software video fixture

measurement-software.webm is an automatically generated, silent 64 x 64 VP8 WebM of changing solid canvas colors, recorded for about 0.6 seconds with Canvas.captureStream and MediaRecorder. It is synthetic software input for upload, decoding, metadata and manifest tests; it contains no head, speaker sound, physical capture, calibration or acceptance evidence.

The frozen bytes were retained from the successfully decoded public-page test on 2026-11-16 (artifacts/b-measurement-evidence/2026-11-16T10-52-32-805Z/synthetic-software-only.webm). Reusing these bytes avoids timing-dependent empty frames when repeatedly generating tiny videos at GPU startup. Product recording behavior remains covered by measurement-page.test.cjs.
